disclosure: Model-assisted advisory review. Four context-free readers, each a fresh instance of the same model family as the author, each given only a group of result documents and their retained transcripts and a fixed rubric (unsupported sentences, overreach, missing caveats, headline verdict, strongest objection). Not independent review under the repository's law; it raises the floor and does not replace a person. Every point that changed a sentence is recorded in the document's own 'Adversarial reading, 2026-09-06' section.
